request.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium entertainment-literacy campaign photography, a single vertical 4:5 photograph with no layout, typography or graphic overlays. A candid, fashion-editorial photograph of two adult friends aged about 40 and 50 taking a relaxed walk through the edge of a beautiful contemporary casino resort lobby at blue hour. One Black woman with cropped natural hair in a deep green silk blouse and one East Asian man with medium-length dark hair in a charcoal casual jacket, mid-conversation, subtle natural smiles, neither looking at the camera. Sophisticated architecture, smoked glass, large sculptural shadows, soft warm lamps, very distant unfocused gaming lights through an opening behind them, no prominent gaming equipment. They are enjoying an ordinary evening together, no wealth spectacle or winning celebration. Shoot from a few steps away on a 50mm lens with the friends occupying the middle-right and lower-middle of the portrait, faces entirely inside the central 60 percent. The upper third of the frame should be mostly a beautiful deep charcoal-blue architectural shadow with very subtle reflected light: usable quiet space for a future headline, no objects or faces there. The lower fifth should be simple dark stone floor and soft reflections, room for a future caption. Do not print any text. Lived-in natural movement, one hand casually in a pocket, anatomically natural visible hands, real skin pores and fine lines, asymmetric candid gestures, tailored yet everyday clothing. Restrained color, rich shadows, realistic warm light on faces, organic subtle film grain, carefully exposed skin. Absolutely no alcohol, drinking glasses, cash, chips, readable signs, screens, brand logos, watermark, glossy plastic skin or stock-photo posing. Full photograph to every edge, no border, no vignette frame.
